info.name: DAtuviSezaH
info.value: ayaM DAtuH 'stutiH' asmin arTe yadA prayujyate, tadA gupUDUpavicCipaRipaniBya AyaH 3.1.28 ityanena asmAt svArTe 'Aya' iti sanAdyantapratyayaH viDIyate . Aya-pratyaye kfte agre SezAtkartari parasmEpadam 1.3.78 ityanena kevalaM parasmEpadasyEva pratyayAH viDIyante . api ca, ayam Aya-pratyayaH ArDaDAtukapratyayasya vivakzAyAm AyAdaya ArDaDAtuke vA 3.1.31 ityanena vikalpyate, ataH pakze Aya-pratyayaM vinA, DAtoH anudAttasvaram anusftya AtmanepadasyEva rUpARi Bavanti . 'vyavahAre' asmin arTe tu Aya-pratyayaH nEva viDIyate, ataH kevalam Atmanepadasya rUpARi Bavanti .

info.name: English Meaning
info.value: to deal, to transact, to do business, to barter, to praise

info.name: hindI arTa
info.value: udyoga karanA, vyavahAra karanA, praSaMsA karanA, stuti karanA
